evidence.name: Screen field: Offer a cheaper plan on cancel
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Offer a cheaper plan on cancel" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Offer a cheaper plan on cancel
sections.description: Controls what happens when someone cancels the payment. When on, they're sent to a downsale screen offering a cheaper or alternative plan — a second chance to recover the sale. When off, cancelling just sends them back with no further offer. Only turn this on if you've actually built a downsale screen in the funnel, otherwise there's nothing for it to open.
